acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Ira talks to Rachel Rosenthal, who spent years trying to figure out who had stolen her identity. She was closing bank account after bank account, getting more and more paranoid, until she realized she knew exactly who the thief was.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Ira’s conversation with Rachel Rosenthal continues. She tells the story of why it took her so long to break up with her boyfriend, even after she figured out that he had stolen from her. We heard about Rachel's story via the podcast Risk!

songs.a: Kyle Duke and the Brown Bags

acts.title: Rachel’s Getting Harried

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Neil Drumming conducts an experiment to find out: can two adults, both new in town, become friends, with the right help?
acts.title: Why Can’t We Be Friends?

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Comedian Kyle Mizono, in a live performance, tells about the time she met her hero, spent a week working with him every day, and it went really well. And then, she emailed him.
acts.title: Hero Today, Gone Tomorrow

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
A short story by Lydia Davis about trying to calculate the cost of a love affair. The story is read by actor Matt Malloy.
Lydia’s new book of collected essays is called Essays One.
acts.title: Break It Down
